claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 µM, nitrofurazone is expected to be largely inactive in human cancer cell lines because its cytotoxicity requires bacterial nitroreductase activation or much higher concentrations (e.g., 500 µM under hypoxia) to damage mammalian cells.
